branch_feedback.message: Keep semantics. Benchmark physical branch representation; storage sharing must not merge epistemic provenance.
Cross-branch pure memoization is sound only with exact/conservative material read/effect contract; incomplete read-set has executable counterexample.
Store exact branch lineage and representation conversion receipts; cache/physical representation non-authoritative.
Use adaptive physical representation only after real trace/VPS measurement; no second PSW organ.
Broadcast/salience neither branch identity nor truth; no new workspace topology required.
May visualize branch/provenance relationships later; no graph authority.
Sharing/compression must not be mislabeled emergence.
Representation finding does not alter latest multimodal feature/cache/epoch semantics.
Existing autotelic interests/goals remain owner-fixed; representation cannot mint goals.
No multi-branch external/effectful execution; proposals only.
ACEF already owns candidate branch/transaction SemanticDelta semantics. PSW result may only inform physical storage/PURE execution policy if ACEF survives; never duplicate branch semantics.
